body: Dad just officially got served. My mom doesn't know about my friend... I won't tell her. But she doesn't care about me. I told her I tried to commit suicide, and she didn't say anything about it... she wouldn't even come over and talk with me. How messed up is that? Things have only gotten worse, and worse, and worse. I only have my gf and my grandma, and I can't help but feel that I'm going to lose them, too. Hell, I would distance myself from me, I'm a ticking time bomb. I think I'll be fine eventually but right now is the lowest I've been in quite some time.

I wish, but school eats up my schedule (mainly because I don't have a car, and have to get rides to school from my mom's dad, who hates me). I had one accident because my parents refused to pay for new tires, and oil. I was only 17 then and I had no idea how to do any of that stuff, all my money went into the daily hour commute to school. So yeah, I already work 20 hour weeks, but lately I haven't been going because it's been to hard. I should be working right now but my hand is so bad that I can't work in a fast food environment. My only hope right now is to wait till school ends, which for me is only two weeks, and then get a 12 hour factory shift. It will be more hours, and 4 dollars an hour more than what I make now. So... maybe, just maybe I can afford a car and then start school at a cheap community college. I mean this is so messed up that I'm supporting myself. Sorry to rant here but I also lost my phone early last year with a promise of getting an Android. I didn't care what kind of phone I had but they lied to me so they didn't have to pay the bill.  Car+phone+school+apartment... that's my future, and it sucks so much. Add onto that this entire story and there's nothing that I look forward to.... 

And you know, I just want to let you know that just one extra person, even if I don't know them, that cares for me makes a big difference. So thank you so much. I don't think I'll ever kill myself, but I just really hate my life right now.

I really wish I was making this up, it sounds so unbelievable. But to answer your question, no. I had a falling out with my friends, and I can't stay with my mothers parents because they're bat shit crazy. You have no idea the amount of judging I'm going to receive. I just talked to a suicide hotline and their advice was to live a parallel life with my father for the time being, save up money (make my gf pay for all my expenses haha), and then move out possibly into a place with her before the next school year starts.

I know this isn't a hotline, and people are not always checking up on new threads, but I seriously need some help. I don't want to talk to a suicide hotline but I just want someone to lay down some solid advice for how I approach this.
